question.question: Describe a time you had to coordinate several marketing tasks with the same deadline.

answer.text: During my internship we had social posts and an event in the same week. I made a list, checked the content calendar and asked the event lead what was most urgent. We finished the materials before the event.

Demonstrates proactive communication by consulting the event lead to align on priorities.
improvements: Add specific details regarding the scale of the tasks (e.g., number of social posts, type of event).
Mention specific tools used for tracking and organization (e.g., Asana, Trello, Excel).
Include measurable outcomes or metrics to demonstrate the success of the execution.

Action: Detail the prioritization methodology, tools used (e.g., content calendar, task management software), and how you communicated with stakeholders.
